### 一、轻量高效

**极致轻量的 Go 实现**：

| 指标           | 数值                            |
| -------------- | ------------------------------- |
| 本地启动耗时   | ~10ms（N5105，SATA 固态上测试） |
| 常驻内存       | ~50MB                           |
| 二进制文件大小 | <30MB                           |

**按需发现工具，节省 Token**： 多数用户把 LLM 当作搜索引擎、写作助手和倾听对象，频繁工具调用并非对话常态[^1][^2]。

ElBot 不在每轮对话中注入所有工具的完整 schema，只暴露 `discover_tool` 和当前可用工具名称；模型需要时再发现详情，由 Agent 注入对应 schema。

所有工具 Schema、Prompt、消息提示精心设计，精准无歧义且大幅减少 Token。

**Chat / Work 双模式**：两种模式可独立配置模型，闲聊用低成本模型，复杂任务用强模型。

| 模式   | 工具               | 适用场景                                 | 第一次请求 Token 消耗      |
| ------ | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `chat` | 不注入             | 闲聊、陪伴、轻量问答、低成本对话         | <500 （后续缓存命中98%+）  |
| `work` | 启用工具发现与调用 | 搜索、文件、命令、Cron、Skill 等复杂任务 | <1000 （后续缓存命中95%+） |

> 注：使用`Responses`协议后，发现工具使用`additional_tools`不再破坏缓存，后续缓存中命中会更高。

**常驻记忆与长期记忆分层**： 常驻记忆只存短小稳定的每轮注入信息，内部区分需确认修改的 core 与可整理的 normal；更长记忆由 LLM 按需通过 `long_memory` 查询，底层用 Markdown 源数据和 SQLite FTS，兼顾透明与检索效率。

**tool_weave**：让模型用 Python 并发、批量调用 ElBot 工具，筛选后只取所需结果，以此节省 Token 和提升速度。[^3] [了解工具编排原理](docs/concepts.md#用-python-编排工具)

ElBot 和 Codex 均使用 `gpt-6.2-astra` 修复 ElBot 的同一个 bug，在代码质量相近的情况下，ElBot 少调用模型 12 次，总 Token 用量低 81.3%。

### 1. Lightweight and Efficient

**Ultra-lightweight Go implementation**:

| Metric           | Value                            |
| -------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Local startup time   | ~10ms (tested on N5105 with SATA SSD) |
| Resident memory       | ~50MB                           |
| Binary size | <30MB                           |

**On-demand tool discovery to save tokens**: Most users treat LLMs as search engines, writing assistants, or listeners; frequent tool calls are not the norm for conversations[^1][^2].

ElBot does not inject the full schema of all tools in every conversation round. It only exposes `discover_tool` and the names of currently available tools; the model discovers details only when needed, and the Agent then injects the corresponding schema.

All tool schemas, prompts, and message hints are carefully designed to be precise and unambiguous while significantly reducing token usage.

**Chat / Work dual modes**: Both modes can be configured with different models independently—use low-cost models for chatting and powerful models for complex tasks.

| Mode   | Tools               | Applicable Scenarios                                 | First request token consumption      |
| ------ | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `chat` | Not injected             | Chatting, companionship, lightweight Q&A, low-cost conversations         | <500 (subsequent cache hit rate 98%+)  |
| `work` | Enable tool discovery and invocation | Complex tasks such as search, files, commands, Cron, Skills, etc. | <1000 (subsequent cache hit rate 95%+) |

> Note: After using the `Responses` protocol, tool discovery via `additional_tools` no longer breaks the cache, leading to higher subsequent cache hit rates.

**Layered resident memory and long-term memory**: Resident memory only stores short, stable information injected into each round, internally distinguishing between `core` (requiring confirmation for modification) and `normal` (organizable). Longer memories are queried by the LLM as needed via `long_memory`, using Markdown source data and SQLite FTS at the bottom to balance transparency and retrieval efficiency.

**tool_weave**: Allows the model to use Python for concurrent and batch calls to ElBot tools, filtering for only the required results to save tokens and increase speed.[^3] [Learn about tool orchestration principles](docs/concepts.md#用-python-编排工具)

Both ElBot and Codex used `gpt-6.2-astra` to fix the same bug in ElBot. With similar code quality, ElBot made 12 fewer model calls and had 81.3% lower total token usage.

### 四、灵活部署与完善会话 **多平台与富输出抽象**： ElBot 抽象了平台层与输出层，目前支持 CLI、QQ OneBot、QQ Official 和 Telegram。平台层可扩展，其他平台按适配器接入。 **CLI 客户端/服务端分离**： ElBot 既可作为客户端也可作为服务端。 **前端自由定制**：可自行制作任意形态的界面，下图仅作示意（除 TUI 外为概念性 mockup，不代表最终 UI）。


完整前端代码及更多截图见 [elbot-showcase/frontend](https://github.com/Elfreese/elbot-showcase/tree/main/frontend)。 **会话、Fork 与上下文压缩**： 内置持久化 Session 服务，支持会话恢复、归档、置顶、Fork、删除、分页查看、平台隔离、压缩等功能。
README.zh-CN.md:section:0a35105ffaaafc2d.translation:
### 4. Flexible Deployment and Comprehensive Sessions **Multi-platform and Rich Output Abstraction**: ElBot abstracts the platform and output layers, currently supporting CLI, QQ OneBot, QQ Official, and Telegram. The platform layer is extensible, and other platforms can be integrated via platform adapters. **CLI Client/Server Separation**: ElBot can function as either a client or a server. **Customizable Frontend**: You can create interfaces in any form; the images below are for illustration purposes only (except for the TUI, these are conceptual mockups and do not represent the final UI).


For the complete frontend code and more screenshots, see [elbot-showcase/frontend](https://github.com/Elfreese/elbot-showcase/tree/main/frontend). **Sessions, Forking, and Context Compaction**: Built-in persistent Session service supporting features such as session recovery, archiving, pinning, forking, deletion, paginated viewing, platform isolation, and compaction.

### 二、强大可扩展

**可扩展的 Hook 系统**： Hook Layer 覆盖 Agent 输入、LLM 请求、LLM 响应、平台发送、平台连接等事件点，可修改消息、追加输出意图、调用脚本。插件可用**任意语言**编写。

**普通 Cron 与 LLM Cron**： 普通 Cron 按计划发送固定内容；LLM Cron 用任务描述驱动模型执行，适合需要分析、归纳或使用工具的定时任务。

**ELyph 任务表示法**： 用结构化语法描述 LLM Cron 与 AgentSkill 的输入、输出、步骤、条件和约束，比自然语言 Markdown 更短、更少歧义，便于 LLM 复用传递，也便于 lint、审计和工具化。

**AgentSkill**：在 `skills/<name>/` 编写可复用的任务说明，推荐 ELyph，也可用自然语言 Markdown。可选的 `ELBOT_SKILL.toml` 能将脚本或可执行文件注册成工具。

**兼容外置 AgentSkill**： 配置后可将符合 agentskills.io 风格的外置 AgentSkill 脚本作为工具使用。
README.zh-CN.md:section:3a437566cb06778e.translation:
### II. Powerful and Extensible

**Extensible Hook System**: The Hook Layer covers event points such as Agent input, LLM requests, LLM responses, platform sending, and platform connections, allowing for message modification, appending output intents, and calling scripts. Plugins can be written in **any language**.

**Standard Cron and LLM Cron**: Standard Cron sends fixed content according to a schedule; LLM Cron uses task descriptions to drive model execution, making it suitable for scheduled tasks that require analysis, summarization, or the use of tools.

**ELyph Task Notation**: Uses structured syntax to describe the inputs, outputs, steps, conditions, and constraints of LLM Cron and AgentSkill. It is shorter and less ambiguous than natural language Markdown, facilitating reuse and transmission by the LLM, as well as linting, auditing, and tooling.

**AgentSkill**: Write reusable task descriptions in `skills/<name>/`; ELyph is recommended, though natural language Markdown can also be used. An optional `ELBOT_SKILL.toml` can register scripts or executable files as tools.

**Compatible with External AgentSkill**: Once configured, external AgentSkill scripts following the agentskills.io style can be used as tools.

README.zh-CN.md:section:6017119cfcc8434a.source:
### 三、Elnis 事件感知系统

**第三种触发方式**： 传统 Agent 只等待用户输入，Cron 只能响应时间；Elnis 让 ElBot 还能被外部事件驱动。

**监听枢纽**： Elnis 是监听枢纽，Elwisp 是分布各处的外部监听器。系统告警、RSS 更新、Webhook、游戏事件等外部信息经 Elwisp 送入 Elnis，交由 ElBot 处理并返回。详见 [Elnis 监听枢纽](docs/elnis.md)。
README.zh-CN.md:section:6017119cfcc8434a.translation:
### III. Elnis Event Perception System

**The third trigger method**: Traditional Agents only wait for user input, and Cron can only respond to time; Elnis allows ElBot to be driven by external events.

**Listening Hub**: Elnis is the listening hub, and Elwisp consists of external listeners distributed everywhere. External information such as system alerts, RSS updates, Webhooks, and game events are sent to Elnis via Elwisp, then processed and returned by ElBot. See [Elnis Listening Hub](docs/elnis.md) for details.

README.zh-CN.md:section:7d500755c3973079.source:
### 五、安全可靠

**安全策略与风险确认**： 工具按风险分级并结合角色权限判断。普通用户只能发现和调用允许范围内的工具，超管调用高风险工具同样需确认。

**轻量沙盒隔离**： 后台 Shell 执行受 AST 级沙盒约束，后台任务拥有独立 sandbox 工作目录。

**日志与审计**： 运行日志、Elwisp 日志与审计日志分离，支持结构化字段与筛选查询；权限拒绝、工具调用、危险确认和 Cron 投递均计入审计。

README.zh-CN.md:section:7d500755c3973079.translation:
### V. Secure and Reliable

**Security Policies and Risk Confirmation**: Tools are categorized by risk level and judged in combination with role permissions. Ordinary users can only discover and call tools within the permitted range; superadmins also require confirmation when calling high-risk tools.

**Lightweight Sandbox Isolation**: Background Shell execution is constrained by an AST-level sandbox, and background tasks have independent sandbox working directories.

**Logs and Auditing**: Runtime logs, Elwisp logs, and audit logs are separated, supporting structured fields and filtered queries; permission denials, tool calls, risk confirmations, and Cron deliveries are all recorded in the audit log.
